title: Frontend: Notification bell — unread count badge and dropdown list
description: Build the notification bell in the app header/sidebar. Shows unread count badge and a dropdown/popover with the notification list.
acceptanceCriteria: Bell icon in sidebar or header
Red badge shows unread count (hidden if 0)
Clicking bell opens a Popover with notification list
'Mark all as read' button in header
Polls for new notifications every 60 seconds

steps.details: Create src/components/notifications/NotificationBell.tsx. Use shadcn/ui Popover. Bell icon with badge overlay showing unreadCount. useQuery to fetch /api/notifications?unreadOnly=false. Refetch every 60 seconds (refetchInterval: 60000).
ScrollArea inside popover (max height 400px). Header with 'Notifications' title + 'Mark all read' button. List of NotificationItem components. Empty state if no notifications.
Add NotificationBell to the AppLayout header or sidebar bottom area.
Create a milestone with a past due date (or manually insert a notification). Verify bell shows badge. Click bell — verify list appears. Click 'Mark all read' — verify count clears.
